title: How to Use Linear With AI Agents for Free (2026)
snippet:
Yes, Linear is free: its [Free plan](https://linear.app/pricing?ref=sharkly.ai) costs $0 for unlimited members, with a cap of 2 teams and 250 issues. And yes, AI agents can use it on that plan. Linear’s pricing table marks MCP access and API access as included on Free, so Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode can read and write your issues through [Linear’s official MCP server](https://linear.app/docs/mcp?ref=sharkly.ai) without an upgrade.

| Piece | Free option | The cap that matters | What you pay beyond it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linear | Free plan | 2 teams, 250 issues, 10MB uploads | Basic at $10 per user/month, billed yearly |
| Linear MCP server | Included on Free | No MCP limit published; API keys get 2,500 requests/hour | $0 |
| Coding agent | OpenCode with a free Zen model | Free “for a limited time”, OpenCode only | Claude Code: a paid Claude plan or API credits. Codex: a ChatGPT plan or API key |
| Sharkly board | Free for organizations up to 5 people | Agents and Computers take no seats | Team at $7 per person/month, billed yearly |
## Linear free plan limits that matter for agents
The Free plan’s headline numbers come straight from the [pricing page](https://linear.app/pricing?ref=sharkly.ai): unlimited members, 2 teams, 250 issues and 10MB file uploads. On Linear’s pricing past Free, paid tiers are Basic at $10 and Business at $16 per user per month, billed yearly.

- **MCP access, API and webhook access, and integrations are all checked on Free** in the pricing comparison table. You don’t need a paid plan to connect an agent.
- **The API has hourly limits.** [Linear’s rate limits](https://linear.app/developers/rate-limiting?ref=sharkly.ai) give API keys 2,500 requests per hour per user, shared across that user’s keys, and OAuth apps 5,000 per hour. Linear doesn’t publish a separate MCP limit.

Linear’s side is already free. The agent side is where “free” usually ends: Claude Code needs a paid Claude plan or API credits, and Codex signs in with a ChatGPT account or an API key whose included usage depends on the plan.
OpenCode is the exception. Its [Zen docs](https://opencode.ai/docs/zen?ref=sharkly.ai) list several models as free “for a limited time” today, including `deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` and `glm-5.3-flash-free`. On October 16, 2026, a clean OpenCode 1.19.2 install (via `npx opencode-ai@latest`) ran `opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` with no sign-in and no API key, and a write-and-run task finished in 32 seconds. title: Linear API: Project Management Tool — Reviews & Pricing [2026] (tools linear api) | aitoolsatlas.ai
snippet:
According to Linear's pricing information reflected in this record, API and webhook access are available on the Free plan, the Free plan includes 2 teams and 250 issues, and paid plans start with Basic at $10 per user per month when billed yearly. The Business plan is listed at $16 per user per month when billed yearly and adds business workflow features such as private teams and guests, Linear Insights, Linear Asks, Zendesk and Intercom integrations, and automation-oriented capabilities. Enterprise pricing is custom and annual, with enterprise controls such as SAML and SCIM, granular admin controls, migration and onboarding support, and priority support and account management.
